sensor_reporting.title: Sensor reporting
sensor_reporting.description: How much a sensor must change before the panel sends Home Assistant a new value. Every value sent is a row in the recorder's database (history, logbook, statistics). Lower numbers give finer history and quicker automations but more database writes; higher numbers mean fewer writes but only larger changes show up. The panel's own brightness, theme and Wi-Fi roaming do not depend on these.

data_description.illuminance_change: Change from the last value sent, in percent; in a dark room at least a third of this number in lux, so sensor noise is not sent. The panel checks the light twice a second, so a light switched on shows up at once. Lower: finer light history and automations that react to small changes. Higher: fewer writes; automations see only bigger changes.
data_description.soc_temperature_change: The processor temperature is read every minute and averaged over about five minutes; a new value is sent when the average moves at least this much. Lower: detailed temperature history. Higher: fewer writes; only larger warming or cooling shows up.
data_description.wifi_signal_change: The signal is read every minute and averaged over about five minutes; a new value is sent when the average moves at least this much. Lower: detailed history, useful for finding weak spots. Higher: fewer writes; short dips do not show up.
